scope: Strict alternative-source adapter for the static PWA, without a runtime proxy, account, subscription or bundled media.

matching.missingIsrc: Hydrate this numeric Deezer track ID through the existing isolated JSONP transport. Cross-check ID, effective title/version, artist, album when present and duration before accepting its ISRC.
audiusChecks: Valid normalized 12-character ISRC equals the requested recording identifier.
Artist name equals the requested artist after Unicode/punctuation normalization; uploader/label names are not guessed as artist aliases.
Effective title/version equals the requested title/version. Only the exact artist's own 'Artist - ' title prefix can be removed.
Duration differs by no more than 3 seconds.
Available, not deleted, streamable, not stream-gated and public stream access explicitly true.
Cover, remix-parent and stem declarations are rejected.
ASCII alphanumeric provider ID only; no arbitrary stream URL from provider JSON is used.
knownLimits: Provider metadata, including ISRC, is not an acoustic fingerprint and cannot guarantee that a malicious or erroneous upload contains the advertised master.
Audius does not expose a directly comparable album title in these responses; the shared recording ISRC identifies the recording independently of album reissues.
Missing ISRC without a matching catalog detail produces no guessed text-search fallback.
No acoustic-comparison implementation or automatic approval of the ALEA recording is included in this adapter.

downloads: The separate is_downloadable flag, non-gated download status and download access must all explicitly permit download. Stream access alone never enables it.

pendingProviders.reason: Public transport and full-audio controls are established, but no acoustic or otherwise trusted mapping to a requested canonical catalog recording was verified. Generic fuzzy substitutions remain disabled.
Public transport and full-audio controls are established, but exact requested recording identity is not established. DJ mixes and same-title matches must not substitute automatically.
Requires an own registered application client_id and live browser identity/full-audio validation. Users would not inherently need accounts for public read methods.
